vibe: High-end financial newspaper meets 2026 tech. Authoritative, grounded, precision. Focus on stark typography, spacious asymmetrical grids, and 1px sharp borders. Do not use glowing gradients or typical tech-SaaS styles.

layout.spacing_system: Generous. Use p-8, p-12, p-24 for section padding.
layout.grid_patterns: Bento grids with 1px solid borders. Asymmetric layouts. Override standard centering with left-aligned optical precision.
layout.borders: 1px solid #E2DED5 on cards, nav, and structural elements. No soft box-shadows. Use sharp corners (rounded-none).

navigation.style: Full-width, sticky top-0 z-50, frosted glass (bg-[#F8F6F0]/90 backdrop-blur-xl) with a sharp 1px bottom border.
navigation.mega_menu: Multi-column panel layout. Grouped by user outcome. Include icons (lucide-react), brief descriptions, and an embedded CTA card for high intent (e.g. 'Get Demo'). Must use hover triggers for desktop.

hero.composition: Editorial split layout. Massive Serif Headline left-aligned. Include a live 'Gold Price Ticker' using IBM Plex Mono.
hero.image_treatment: Use abstract gold texture or real office photography within a strict 1px border. No full-screen dark overlays.

cards.style: Flat background (bg-[#F8F6F0] or bg-[#EFECE4]), 1px solid border (#E2DED5), rounded-none. On hover, apply a slight brutalist shift (-translate-y-1) and a sharp hard shadow (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0C0B0A]).

buttons.primary: bg-[#0C0B0A] text-[#F8F6F0] hover:bg-[#B48E4B] hover:text-[#0C0B0A] transition-colors rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-medium flex items-center justify-center
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#0C0B0A] text-[#0C0B0A] hover:bg-[#EFECE4] transition-colors rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-medium flex items-center justify-center

hero_accent.description: Abstract matte gold texture for hero accent panel

office_lifestyle.description: High-end investment professionals meeting. Use in Process or Dashboard section context.

architecture_accent.description: Warm lit corporate architecture, use as a bento box filler or testimonial background image.

instructions_to_main_agent: Remove all existing dark theme, generic neon/purple gradients, and Inter font usage.
Implement the 'Editorial Finance' aesthetic. This requires sharp edges, off-white/linen backgrounds (#F8F6F0), and high contrast black (#0C0B0A) text.

Rebuild the Navigation component to include a full-width Mega Menu. The Mega Menu must feature multi-column layouts, lucide-react icons, and short descriptions for sub-items under 'Platform', 'Reports', etc.
Update the Tailwind configuration or layout.tsx to load Cormorant Garamond (heading), Outfit (body), and IBM Plex Mono (labels/data).
Design the Hero section like a financial newspaper's front page: huge serif headline ('Smarter Gold Planning for Smarter Businesses'), a monospace gold price ticker, and sharp structural borders.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for main marketing sections to allow creative asymmetric grids, avoiding generic Shadcn Cards unless for complex interactive components.
Every interactive or informational element MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='mega-menu-platform', data-testid='hero-cta-button').
